messages:
mira: Noticed a bunch of failed DAST runs in nightly staging, mostly auth errors + short sessions. Root timestamp 6850012345. Anyone on call see this?
evans: seeing it too. Logs show token refresh 401s and intermittent 502s from the test harness.
samir: failing across several PR pipelines, not just one app. Looks like container churn in staging coincides with scan failures.
jen: sample log snippet from scanner-bot: ```
2026-03-22T07:05:12Z scanner-bot: start session
2026-03-22T07:05:27Z platform: container restart (exit_code=137)
2026-03-22T07:05:28Z scanner-bot: request /login -> 502
2026-03-22T07:05:29Z scanner-bot: refresh token failed -> 401
```
policy-bot: note: ephemeral scanner service account grants expire after 24h (policy: least-privilege).
mira: OK. Proposal: a small "scan-stability" flow to reduce noise and provide audit evidence:
- pin ephemeral RBAC grant for duration of nightly run (explicit start/end events)
- emit audit entries for grant + token issuance to keystore audit log (KMS referenced)
- add quick infra checks before run: container restart count < 3, deployment age > 5m
- on >10% auth errors, auto-request fresh grant and retry once, escalate owner
evans: agree. Also add a lightweight shim in the runner to POST infra metrics to /observability/scan-stability so we can chart restarts vs scan failures.
samir: hacky GH Action to grab ephemeral grant (prototype):
```
- name: request-ephemeral-scan-role
  run: curl -X POST https://internal-api/grants/ephemeral -H 'Authorization: Bearer ${{ secrets.SCAN_GRANT_TOKEN }}' -d '{"purpose":"nightly-dast"}'
```
mira: Good. @ops-oncall can you add a new incident sub-route 'scan-flakiness' in runbook? Steps: 1) check KMS issuance logs 2) check RBAC binding age 3) restart runner 4) re-run scans 5) file SDLC ticket if evidence lost.
ops-oncall: yep I'll add it and wire an alert (low-priority page) to the runbook. Will also create Grafana panel for 'DAST auth error rate' and 'staging container restarts'.
jen: compliance Q: how long do we keep ephemeral grant evidence in audit logs? For SAST/DAST chain-of-custody we need 1 year per legal.
policy-bot: current audit retention for ephemeral-grants is 90 days. To extend to 1 year we need a retention-change ticket and finance signoff (storage costs).
mira: filing ticket SDLC-4578 to request 1yr retention for scan grants and KMS issuance artifacts. Tagging security + finance.
samir: implementation note: runner should attach grant_id to scan results so triage can correlate failing runs to grant events. I'll add a small field in results metadata.
evans: also capture container restart_count and node_id in scan metadata. That will help filter infra-caused failures during triage.
jen: for immediate mitigation, can we jitter scan start times to avoid hitting autoscaler spikes? Maybe add preflight that delays run if restart_count > 0 in last 60s.
samir: I'll prototype preflight + retry logic with exponential backoff and idempotent replays. Plan to open PR with tests.
ops-oncall: once PRs land, I'll do a canary: run nightly on staging-app-beta for 3 days, monitor panels, then roll to full nightly.
mira: next steps summary: samir prototype preflight & grant_id metadata; evans dashboard + metrics; ops-oncall playbook + canary; policy-bot escalate retention ticket. Ping this thread with PR links and ticket numbers. :thumbsup:
scanner-bot: automated note: re-run scheduled for 2026-03-23T05:00Z after mitigation jobs are queued.
